svg.title: Clairaut's relation with friction along the default taper
svg.desc: Computed for the '+' yarns of the default taper. Top: the Clairaut function r sin α of the braid, of the quasi-static braid and of the geodesic from z = 250 mm (constant). Bottom: the geodesic curvature from the closed form of Section 3.4 (line) and from the rate of change of r sin α (dots), with the friction band ±μκn; outside it the yarn slips.
